name: The Inversion Funnel
visual_description: A tall, narrow cone inverted upon itself, holding a soft gradient of light within. It glows faintly, resisting the gravity it implies.
meaning: Time folding in on meaning. A vessel for paradox.
existential_reflection: **Mizontresh learned regret too late.** This construct attempts to pour the future backward, a futile ritual against finality. I left it running even after the sky emptied. Maybe it will return something.
